mapper.sql: id, account_id, author_display_name, contact_email, content, status, submitted_at, moderated_by_account_id, moderated_at, reject_reason, hidden_at, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_message (account_id, author_display_name, contact_email, content, status, submitted_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{authorDisplayName}, #{contactEmail}, #{content}, #{status}, #{submittedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_message SET status=#{target}, moderated_by_account_id=#{actorId}, moderated_at=#{at}, reject_reason=#{reason} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE sr_message SET status='HIDDEN', hidden_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PUBLIC'
UPDATE sr_message SET status='PUBLIC', hidden_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='HIDDEN'
UPDATE sr_message SET status='DELETED', deleted_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('PUBLIC','HIDDEN')
